title: Why You Feel a Sudden Jerk Just as You're Falling Asleep
hook: Why do you suddenly jerk awake just as you're falling asleep?

narration.text: That sudden jolt as you drift off, known as a hypnic jerk, is very common.
It happens when your brain misinterprets the relaxation of your muscles as you sleep.
As your body begins to relax, your breathing and heart rate slow down.
Your brain sometimes thinks you are actually falling and sends a signal to your muscles.
This causes a sudden, involuntary contraction, making you jump.
It is completely harmless and part of a normal sleep transition.
Many factors, including stress or caffeine, can make these jerks more frequent.
Have you ever experienced a hypnic jerk, and what did it feel like?

description: Ever experienced a sudden jolt just as you're drifting off to sleep? This video explains the fascinating reason behind these hypnic jerks, a common and harmless sleep phenomenon. Discover what your brain is doing and why your body reacts this way.
topic: Why you might feel a sudden jerk just as you are falling asleep, known as a hypnic jerk.
